---
title: "Parameter Expansion and Default Values"
---

# Parameter Expansion and Default Values

Parameter expansion allows you to inspect, modify, and assign fallback values to variables without invoking external tools like `sed` or `awk`.

## Default Values and Fallbacks

```bash
# Use default if unset or empty: ${VAR:-default}
user_input=""
username="${user_input:-guest}"
echo "$username" # guest

# Assign default if unset or empty: ${VAR:=default}
# (Note: Does not work on positional parameters like $1)
${DATABASE_HOST:="localhost"}

# Throw error and exit if unset or empty: ${VAR:?error_message}
: "${CONFIG_FILE:?Error: CONFIG_FILE environment variable must be set}"

# Use alternate value if set and non-empty: ${VAR:+alternate}
${DEBUG:+"--verbose"}
```

## String Slicing and Length

```bash
text="LinuxDistribution"

# String length: ${#VAR}
echo "${#text}" # 17

# Substring extraction: ${VAR:offset:length}
echo "${text:0:5}"   # Linux
echo "${text:5}"     # Distribution
echo "${text: -4}"   # tion (note the space before negative offset)
```

## Pattern Stripping and Substitution

```bash
filepath="/var/log/nginx/access.log.tar.gz"

# Strip shortest match from front: ${VAR#pattern}
echo "${filepath#*/}"     # var/log/nginx/access.log.tar.gz

# Strip longest match from front: ${VAR##pattern} (equivalent to basename)
echo "${filepath##*/}"    # access.log.tar.gz

# Strip shortest match from back: ${VAR%pattern}
echo "${filepath%.*}"     # /var/log/nginx/access.log.tar

# Strip longest match from back: ${VAR%%pattern}
echo "${filepath%%.*}"    # /var/log/nginx/access

# Replace first match: ${VAR/pattern/replacement}
echo "${filepath/log/archive}"

# Replace all matches: ${VAR//pattern/replacement}
echo "${filepath//\//_}"  # _var_log_nginx_access.log.tar.gz
```
